headline:
Your TRIM notice
isn't a tax bill.
[[It's a deadline.]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
deck: Every Broward property owner got one in August. You have until September 18 to challenge the number if it's wrong.
takeaway: Filing costs nothing. Skipping it costs you for a year.
